o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آنا (ana), from Proto-Turkic *ana. Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (ana, “mother”).
From Persian فاحشهخانه (fâheše-xâne). By surface analysis, fahişə + -xana.
From Classical Persian استحکام (istihkām), from Arabic اِسْتِحْكَام (istiḥkām).
From at- + -ış. The sense 'club together' is likely a semantic loan from Russian ски́дываться (skídyvatʹsja)/ски́нуться (skínutʹsja).
From Arabic وَسَائِط (wasāʔiṭ). The sense 'handbook' is a semantic loan from Russian посо́бие (posóbije).
